name: MindMap AI
description:
MindMap AI lets you create, search, view, edit, style, and export mind maps right inside Claude, and see them rendered in the chat as you work. Create a map from a topic, a brainstorm, meeting notes, or documents you share in the conversation. Then keep refining it through chat: expand branches, add relationship arrows to build concept maps, group ideas with summary brackets, and reorganize the structure. Switch between mind map, logic chart, and org chart layouts, apply themes, and export when you're done. Great for brainstorming, studying, planning, and visualizing ideas as a clear outline.

Your maps are saved to your MindMap AI account, where you can keep mind mapping on the canvas with full styling control. Connecting is free and includes bonus credits to get started. Map creation and edits use credits from your MindMap AI account; viewing and exporting your maps never uses credits (available export formats follow your plan), and manual editing on the canvas is always free.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MindMap AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MindMap AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mindmapai.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MindMap AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MindMap AI lists 20 MCP tools, including add_arrows, add_nodes, add_summaries, create_project, delete_arrows, delete_nodes, delete_project, delete_summaries, export_project, get_canvas, get_schema, and list_projects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MindMap AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MindMap AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does MindMap AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: MindMap AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MindMap AI is developed by MindMap AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
